pitch:
MLOps.dev — Autonomous fleet operations and drift circuit breakers for edge AI hardware.
One-line agent install: curl -fsSL https://www.mlopsde.me/install.sh | sudo bash
Zero-downtime delta OTA updates (12MB vs 500MB) with automatic KL-divergence drift detection.
If accuracy drops, the agent rolls back to your last verified model in under 300ms.
Starter tier: Free for up to 10 edge devices. Team tier: $149/mo for up to 50 devices with automated canary gates.
Air-gapped and offline-first — your model weights never touch unencrypted third-party clouds.
